name: edit_component
description: Update visibility, description, or tags on a component YOU published to 21st.dev. Owner-only - the slug must belong to the signed-in caller (404 otherwise). Provide at least one field; omitted fields are left as-is. `tags`, when provided, REPLACES the full tag set.

slug.description: The component's slug (from a search with mine:true, or the studio URL).

tags.description: Tag slugs - REPLACES the full tag set.

visibility.description: New access. Use published or private; public/unlisted are temporary compatibility aliases.
